recap.analyst:
Coloso Ciudad beat Navigli United 1-0. On expected goals it finished 0.94–0.22: Coloso Ciudad created the better chances and the result reflects it.

Navigli United had 57% of the ball. Pass completion COL 70% (106/152), NAV 81% (175/216). Shots 9–3, on target 1–0.

Coloso Ciudad started in a 4-2-3-1 (direct), Navigli United in a 5-4-1 (direct). In-game changes: NAV to 3-4-3 at 68' (chasing the game); COL to 5-4-1 at 83' (protecting the lead).

Turning point, 22': Coloso Ciudad broke the deadlock through Z. Bauer. The chance was worth xG 0.08 (about 8 in 100 go in), struck at 98 km/h. Score now COL 1-0 NAV. It proved to be the winner.

By the numbers: S. Sørensen completed the most passes (35); B. Pavlov hit the top speed (31.2 km/h); T. Dalgaard covered the most ground (6.11 km, a 17.2 km per-90 pace); Z. Bauer won the most challenges (15).

Discipline: fouls 3–4, yellows 2–2, offsides 1–0. Conditions: partly cloudy, 15°C, pitch damp.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at Estadio Coloso, Mexico City. Z. Bauer broke the deadlock in the 22nd minute. Navigli United pushed for a way back, switching to a 3-4-3 in the 68th minute, but Coloso Ciudad held firm. The hero: Z. Bauer, with the goal that mattered. At the final whistle, Coloso Ciudad celebrate in front of their fans.
